sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is Z.ai's first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. It is a 320B Mixture-of-Experts model with 18B active parameters, built for coding, agentic work, and visual tasks, and released under the MIT License.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash Launch — Ox Alpha Was Zhipu (MIT) - explainx.ai
sources.snippet: Z.ai's launch blog is explicit about the strategy: test anonymously on OpenCode and OpenRouter, become "the most popular model of the week," then ship under the GLM brand with open weights. Hunter Alpha and Healer Alpha → MiMo was the same playbook from a different lab. What changes for builders now: Route to z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (or Hugging Face locally) instead of guessing about stealth/ox ...

sources.snippet: MLX (Apple Silicon) runtime and quantization tooling for zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash — 320B-A18B: 34 Kimi-Delta linear-attention layers interleaved with 11 DeepSeek-sparse-attention layers (NoPE MLA behind a lightning indexer), 288-expert MoE, manifold-constrained hyper-connections (model_type: glm5_next).
